project.title: Search for the Egg
project.genre: cozy first-person collection and hidden-object simulator

evidenceLabels.VERIFIED: Directly visible in the supplied recording or official surface
evidenceLabels.CORROBORATED: Supported by multiple current public sources
evidenceLabels.ASSUMED: Chosen for production because direct evidence is unavailable; must stay tunable

round.assumption: ASSUMED except count-up timer and skippable cutscene

beats.text: An Egg hidden inside a mountain of feathers...

intro.evidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026 (reference clip): a 12-16 second round intro - poster reveal, the player's own avatar walking in and taking the flyer, then a farmhouse reveal. Camera markers are named so framing is tuned by moving the marker parts or editing these numbers, never by rewriting code. maxWaitSeconds is the multiplayer backstop: the round leaves the intro as soon as every present member reports ready, and at the latest when this elapses. The poster's reward is computed from the chapter and difficulty actually being played, never written here.

pile.rainbowChanceEvidence: OWNER 14 Sep 2026 (clip review): at 1.5% roughly 900 records were rainbow and 5-8 were in view at all times with halo sprites smearing over neighbours. 0.35% puts about one in 285 records, a couple in view, and the halo is gone.

collision.bodyEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026 (screenshots of the mound foot): the body was a 3-stud slab tilted to the surface normal, so on the steep rim neighbouring slabs rotated apart and their lower edges hung above the sand; a low sight line went between them, under the coat and out the far side. The body is now one solid axis-aligned column per cell, buried bodyBuryStuds below the nest floor, so no camera angle can see under it. The lip that held the outermost boxes above the sand was removed on 15 Sep 2026: with the dome landing on the sand it only stood a ring of bare bricks on the ground past the coat's edge.
collision.visibleEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026 (screenshot from inside a dug pile, and the tunnel measurements after it): the body was visible so that a thin coat could not be seen under, and being visible forced it to sit below the whole coat so it would not bury the records - which put it eleven studs under the feathers on a pit wall, i.e. a player falling through a wall they can see. It is invisible again and tops out just under the surface: it hides nothing it overlaps, so the coat's lower records stay visible and cover the drop themselves, and you stand where the feathers are. What keeps a sight line from going under the mound is coatSlotsAt measuring each column's coat against the neighbours it actually has, rather than against the dome as first built.
collision.colorEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026 (screenshot from inside a dug pile): the body was 235,229,216 - brighter than every feather in the palette except the top highlight - so anywhere it showed it read as a white brick rather than as mass. It is now between the two darkest palette entries (184,172,146 and 150,138,114), which is where a depth-tinted feather at the bottom of the coat already sits, so a sliver between strands reads as shadow under the coat instead of as a wall.
collision.rewriteEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026: the dent map and the rewrite threshold are both gone. Records are the only thing that moves this surface, and the body is re-seated on every accepted award, so the collision, the coat and the saved grid cannot disagree. digRadiusStuds/strikeDentDepthStuds/sweepDentDepthStuds/sweepDigRadiusStuds/rewriteEveryRecords fed that system and were removed with it.

pickup.evidence: OWNER 16 Sep 2026 (two-clip comparison): a pick has to read as one transaction - target, contact, that exact feather flying to the bundle, the bundle taking it, the counter moving at the landing - in about 0.3 s, with the next click free before the last one lands. press + release + flight = 0.295 s.

readability.evidence: OWNER 16 Sep 2026 (clip comparison): sampled saturation ~14 vs the reference's ~26.5 and the whole frame brighter, so white feathers lost their creases. Exposure and bloom come down, ambient warms and darkens a little, contrast and saturation nudge up; the feathers stay feathers.

visual.frontSkirtEvidence: OWNER 14 Sep 2026: fixed overlapping strands cover the small gap at the mound's front rim (spawn side); not records, never picked
visual.layEvidence: OWNER 14 Sep 2026: surface feathers lie tangent with overlapping tips (tilt 2-9 deg, roll +-20 deg), ivory-to-grey palette for depth, newly exposed records fade in beneath the removed one instead of popping
visual.depthEvidence: ASSUMED 14 Sep 2026: a sweep or suction tick never takes more than maxPerCell records from one cell, so every accepted record is one of the rendered (top 10) feathers and the excavation spreads along the tool's contact area instead of tunnelling one cell
visual.scaleEvidence: OWNER 14 Sep 2026 (clip review): feathers were 2.4-3.4 studs, about half a character, so the mound read as pillows and every pickup was a visible chunk. A feather is now ~1.2 studs; the same record count reads as thousands of small pieces.
visual.shadingEvidence: OWNER 14 Sep 2026 (clip review): the mound was uniformly white with no depth cue. Records now tint down the palette with their depth in the column (depthTintWeight of the colour comes from depth over depthTintSlots records).
visual.rimEvidence: OWNER 14 Sep 2026 (clip review): the rim read as a spiky ball. Rim feathers taper to rimMinScale over rimTaperStuds and pitch down by rimCurlDegrees so the edge curls under.
visual.lumpEvidence: OWNER 14 Sep 2026 (clip review): the dome is a perfect mathematical profile until it is dug, so it read as a smooth blob. Rendered feathers are seated along a smooth deterministic undulation of this amplitude; the logical surface, aim and collision are untouched.
visual.gapEvidence: OWNER 14 Sep 2026: bare sand showed through near the foot. The undulation was sinking thin-coat feathers below ground and the rim taper thinned the cover over too wide a band; the lump now fades with coat height, nothing seats below the floor, and the taper is narrower.
visual.coatDepthEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026 (screenshot of the mound foot): with a fixed 7 records per column the coat is about 0.9 studs deep while the dome drops ~1 stud per 0.6-stud cell on the rim, so each ring's coat ended above the next ring's coat and a band of bare body showed between them as a smooth wall. Columns now render ceil((drop*coatDropCoverage + coatDropMarginStuds)/step)+1 records, capped at maxVisibleSlotsPerCell, so the band is covered by real pickable feathers instead of a wall. Raised to 1.8/0.4 on 15 Sep 2026 after the owner could still pick out the body between strands at close range: 22,104 coat parts against the 26,000 budget.
visual.mobileCoatEvidence: ASSUMED 15 Sep 2026: the adaptive coat window is capped at 4 on a low tier (9,144 coat parts for the 54x54 grid) so a phone is not asked for the desktop coat. The body is feather-coloured and solid, so the low tier shows slightly more packed mass between strands but never a see-through gap.
visual.interiorEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026 (stood inside a shaft dug to the floor): the mound was hollow. The coat only draws the top slots of each column, so a horizontal sight line from the bottom of an excavation passes under every neighbouring column's coat and out to the sand - measured at 151 of 396 rays hitting Ground.TanClearing from an eye one stud above the shaft floor. _exposeWalls and _exposeFloor were written for exactly this and were both set to 0. Wall strands line a neighbour's newly exposed face from the bottom of its coat down to the pit floor; floor strands pack a dug column below its own render window. Both add parts only where somebody has actually dug.
visual.capEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026: the coat window was capped at 22 slots. A centre column holds 32 records at a step of 0.5 studs, so even a column standing over a hole to the floor could only draw 11 studs of a 16-stud face and the bottom five studs were open air. The cap is the column itself now (32), so a wall renders every record it has - real, pickable feathers rather than filler - and only columns beside a drop ever ask for that many.
visual.budgetEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026: 26,000 was the target from when the mound was a hollow shell - and it was never enforced on anything but the initial fluff bed, which allocates nothing. A mound whose interior is genuinely packed costs about 24k surface records plus wall filler that grows with how much has been dug: measured at 42k parts with 8.8% of the mound excavated across eight craters. The number now says what the system actually costs. Phones line a face at wallStrandsPerLevelMobile instead, on top of their much shallower coat window.
visual.decorativeEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026 (clip of the vacuum hollowing the mound, then the audit): every rendered record was correct - 22,109 instances, 0 ghosts, 0 orphans, 0 duplicates - and 11,374 decorative strands were visible: wall filler, underlayer sheets and the front skirt, CanQuery=false and carrying no id. Those are the feathers that floated in the cavity and could not be collected, and the ones the hand ray passed through to claim a record behind. If it looks like a feather the player must be able to collect it, so every decorative source is zero; the mound is records and nothing else.
visual.solidEvidence: OWNER 16 Sep 2026 (standing on the sand inside a vacuumed cavity, looking up through the walls): there must be no space inside the mound, and every visible strand must be a record. A record was 0.09 studs thick stacked every 0.5, so from the side a column was mostly air. Thickness is now 0.5 (the crown step) so consecutive records touch; width starts above the 0.54 cell pitch so neighbouring columns abut; slabs are longer, tilted 5-32 degrees and yawed at random so the stack interlocks the way the reference's straw does. No filler, no body: the middle is closed by records alone.

pile.depthEvidence: ASSUMED 14 Sep 2026: 48x48 cells of 0.6 studs (same 28.8-stud footprint), records every 0.15 studs of column height capped at 32 per cell (~55k records) so the mound reads ~20-25 min of tool digging to the egg at minimumRemovalFraction; visible coat is the top 10 records per cell
pile.minRecordsEvidence: OWNER 14 Sep 2026 (clip review): rim columns held one or two records, so a rake sweep at the edge paid +1 while the same swing on the slope paid +27 and the reward felt random. Every column now holds at least this many records; the mound's height is unchanged because height is remaining/base.
pile.gridEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026 (screenshots of the mound foot): the dome profile reached zero at 1.15x the grid radius but the grid stopped at 1.0x, so the mound ended in a 1.5-3 stud cliff around its whole foot. RIM_STRETCH is now 1.0 and the grid is 54x54 at 0.54 studs: the footprint (14.6 studs) and silhouette are unchanged and the record total is 59,864 against the previous 59,936, so digging pacing is preserved while the mound lands on the sand.

plume.evidence: OWNER 17 Sep 2026 (Plume simplification): the Egg Sense rod was far too strong and is gone. Professor Plume's analysis costs rainbowCost Rainbow Feathers from the player's carried bag, consumed server-side, once per round per player, and reveals ONE vague clue chosen by the server: a half of the nest (barn/fence side or back/front half, axis picked at random) with probability directionChance, otherwise a depth band from the Egg's covering fraction (below shallowBelow = near the surface, at or above deepFrom = deep, else middling). Never both, never a marker. requestCooldownSeconds is the per-player server-side rate limit.
plume.assumption: OWNER cost, once-per-round and one-vague-clue rule; ASSUMED direction chance, depth band edges and cooldown

survey.evidence: OWNER 17 Sep 2026 (Molly simplification): a clear top-down nest map in four large labelled areas (BACK BARN, BACK FENCE, FRONT BARN, FRONT FENCE; BARN is the yard's west, BACK its north). Three surveys per party per round, paid in normal feathers at 100, 200 and 400 in that order; each picks one area and answers only STRONG SIGNAL (the Egg is inside it), WEAK SIGNAL (outside, but within weakBorderFraction of the nest's width/depth of that area's border) or NO SIGNAL. No coordinates, sub-cells or pins. Rainbow Feathers are never touched.
survey.assumption: OWNER costs, limit, four areas and three-word answer; ASSUMED weak margin, range and sequence length

nestRake.shapeEvidence: ASSUMED 14 Sep 2026: the sweep's contact area is a narrow fan - cells within sweepHalfWidthStuds either side of the swing line, from sweepAheadStuds past the strike back toward the player for sweepRadiusStuds - centre-heavy (focusWeight from the struck cell); a strike on bare ground re-centres within reachStuds. Accepted records animate one after another every streamStaggerSeconds.

confettiCharge.evidence: VERIFIED soft/permanent public; ASSUMED one-round price and mechanics values
confettiCharge.shapeEvidence: ASSUMED 14 Sep 2026: a blast digs a bowl - the closest cells give up to craterDepthRecords each, tapering with distance until the yield is spent - so the crater is deep in the middle instead of one record from every cell in the radius
confettiCharge.throwEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026: the charge must be throwable at any valid world position inside throwDistanceStuds and must never snap toward the pile. The throw resolves against the nearest of the mound surface and the first solid thing in the world instead of the pile-reaching aim rule, carries to the end of its range and falls throwFloorDropStuds to the ground when it meets nothing, and clamps to the range measured flat from the character rather than refusing. A throw away from the pile still lands, explodes and plays its effects, and simply finds no feathers.

offer.evidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026: the supplied 2x Gems artwork is the whole lobby button, left side, lobby only. Motion is a slow float, a travelling glint and a hover lift; no particles and no light, so nothing it does reaches the world.

feedback.evidence: OWNER 17 Sep 2026: denial feedback (not enough money, bag full, still cooling, can't use) spammed a sound and a toast on every press. A refusal now shows and sounds once, then the same reason stays quiet for denialCooldownSeconds - on the client (UI/Feedback.deny, keyed by reason) and on the server for denial events it pushes (keyed by player and reason). A toast whose text matches one shown within notificationDedupeSeconds is merged into it, so one event never builds two notifications.

carriedStack.compositionEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026: the bundle had to read larger, fuller and organised, and had to show what the player is actually carrying. maxVisibleFeathers 12 -> 18 over three overlapping depth layers, frame width 0.19 -> 0.26 of the viewport (170-330px, still clamped inside the safe area), carried Rainbow Feathers appear as animated rainbow feathers at the front of the bundle (emissive surface and motes, no light instance, so nothing else is tinted), and a sale flies the bundle out instead of deleting it.

toolFeel.evidence: ASSUMED first-person tool feel (owner clips not attached on 14 Sep 2026); tune per clip

confettiCharge.craterEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026: the scorch disc was left in the world until the round ended, so a few charges tiled the nest with permanent black circles. It holds for craterSeconds and fades out over craterFadeSeconds.

ui.toast.evidence: OWNER 14 Sep 2026 notification id (commit 454c375). Played once per notification that actually shows: merged duplicates and refusals (which play ui.error) stay silent.

collect.release.evidence: OWNER 16 Sep 2026: this is the landing transient (played when the feather reaches the bundle, not when the server answers); the reference's strongest transients measured ~11 dB above ours, so it is louder and its pitch spread tighter.

audio.evidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026 supplied six ids: nest rake/shovel 81267530921314 at the contact moment, feather vac 91395529514868 as a managed loop while sucking, dynamite 124256466623788 at the explosion, class result 90853027572825 once the spinner lands, in-round music 130867147321580 (lobby silent), and the upgrade book page flip 114448027739800 once per real page change. The spinner's slap (class.spin) is silenced, tool.rakeSwing and tool.vacSuck are silenced so each tool makes exactly one sound, and ui.error shares a denial throttle group with collect.bagFull so one refusal is one sound whatever fires it. Every id, volume, speed, variance, loop flag and cooldown lives here rather than in code.
audio.introEvidence: PLACEHOLDER 15 Sep 2026: the owner supplied no ids for the round intro's farm ambience, wind, footsteps, paper rustle or decision sting, so intro.ambience/wind/footstep/paper/sting are silent here rather than guessed. intro.type uses a bundled Roblox click so the subtitle reveal is not silent. Fill these five ids in and the intro picks them up with no code change.
audio.feedbackEvidence: OWNER 17 Sep 2026: unapproved feedback sounds removed. round.countdownTick (the per-second tick under the lobby pad countdown and the round countdown) is gone - round.countdownGo and party.ready still mark the start. collect.rainbow (the extra ping layered on a Rainbow Feather pickup, vac award and sale) is gone - a Rainbow pickup sounds like any pickup. ui.toast (a pop on every notification) is gone - toasts are silent. collect.bagFull was the same refusal asset as ui.error under a second role; bag full now goes through UI/Feedback.deny like every other refusal, which plays ui.error once and then holds that reason quiet for hud.feedback.denialCooldownSeconds. The vac's cooled-down ui.confirm chime, the sale popup's ui.confetti pop, the RewardGranted reward.tick and a second egg.chime on the carrier's own claim were callers stacking a sound on an event that already had one, and were removed at the caller.
audio.clickEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026: one ordinary UI click sound (15675059323) on every click-shaped role, all sharing the uiClick throttle group so two callers for a single press still make exactly one sound. Opening a UI is silent: ui.open has no id. The page flip keeps its own role and its own group so a page turn is never stacked with a click.
audio.fuseEvidence: OWNER 17 Sep 2026: the charge made a slap when lit - tool.fuseLight was Roblox's stock snap.mp3, a finger snap. It is silent now; the fuse's voice is tool.fuseHiss, a firework fuse sizzle from Roblox's free library (71438605239854, loops while the fuse burns), and tool.blastLow layers a Pro Sound Effects deep boom (9125484367) under the owner's explosion so the blast has a floor.
audio.swordEvidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026: sell.arc and tool.throw were both rbxasset://sounds/unsheath.wav - Roblox's stock sword-draw - so selling a bag and throwing a charge each made a sword noise. Both are silenced. The sale still has sell.tick and sell.burst, and a throw still has the fuse and the blast, so neither action lost its voice; it lost a sound that belonged to a different game.

dailyQuests.evidence: OWNER 15 Sep 2026: daily quests did not exist. Three are drawn per player per day, deterministically from the player and the day so a rejoin shows the same three. Targets and gem rewards are assumptions pending owner numbers; the metrics are all counters the server already produces, so progress never touches the collection hot path.
